# apple_certificates (Data Source)

Retrieves information about Certificates from Apple App Store Connect.

This data source allows you to query and filter Certificates based on various criteria such as certificate type, platform, name patterns, and serial numbers. It supports sorting and limiting results.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    apple = {
      source  = "mathgaps/apple"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# Configure the Apple Provider
provider "apple" {
  # Authentication via environment variables:
  # APPLE_APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID
  # APPLE_APP_STORE_CONNECT_API_KEY
  # APPLE_APP_STORE_CONNECT_PRIVATE_KEY
}

# Query all certificates
data "apple_certificates" "all" {
  # No filters - returns all certificates
}

# Query only iOS Development certificates
data "apple_certificates" "ios_development" {
  certificate_type = "IOS_DEVELOPMENT"
  platform         = "IOS"
  sort_by          = "display_name"
  sort_order       = "asc"
}

# Query certificates by multiple types
data "apple_certificates" "distribution_certificates" {
  certificate_types = [
    "IOS_DISTRIBUTION",
    "MAC_APP_DISTRIBUTION"
  ]
  sort_by    = "expiration_date"
  sort_order = "desc"
  limit      = 10
}

# Query certificates with name pattern
data "apple_certificates" "production_certificates" {
  name_pattern = "*Production*"
  sort_by      = "certificate_type"
}

# Query certificates by specific serial number
data "apple_certificates" "specific_certificate" {
  serial_number = "A1B2C3D4E5F6"
  limit         = 1
}

# Output all certificates
output "all_certificates" {
  value = [for cert in data.apple_certificates.all.certificates : {
    id               = cert.id
    display_name     = cert.display_name
    certificate_type = cert.certificate_type
    serial_number    = cert.serial_number
    expiration_date  = cert.expiration_date
    platform         = cert.platform
  }]
}

# Output iOS Development certificates
output "ios_dev_certificates" {
  value = {
    count       = length(data.apple_certificates.ios_development.certificates)
    total_count = data.apple_certificates.ios_development.total_count
    certificates = [for cert in data.apple_certificates.ios_development.certificates : {
      display_name    = cert.display_name
      serial_number   = cert.serial_number
      expiration_date = cert.expiration_date
    }]
  }
}

# Output distribution certificates
output "distribution_certificates" {
  value = {
    filtered_count = data.apple_certificates.distribution_certificates.filtered_count
    certificates = [for cert in data.apple_certificates.distribution_certificates.certificates : {
      display_name     = cert.display_name
      certificate_type = cert.certificate_type
      expiration_date  = cert.expiration_date
    }]
  }
}

# Output production certificates
output "production_certificates" {
  value = [for cert in data.apple_certificates.production_certificates.certificates : {
    display_name     = cert.display_name
    certificate_type = cert.certificate_type
    requester_email  = cert.requester_email
  }]
}

# Output specific certificate details (sensitive data excluded)
output "specific_certificate" {
  value = length(data.apple_certificates.specific_certificate.certificates) > 0 ? {
    found            = true
    display_name     = data.apple_certificates.specific_certificate.certificates[0].display_name
    certificate_type = data.apple_certificates.specific_certificate.certificates[0].certificate_type
    expiration_date  = data.apple_certificates.specific_certificate.certificates[0].expiration_date
    } : {
    found = false
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `certificate_type` (String) Filter Certificates by type. Valid values include:
- `IOS_DEVELOPMENT` - iOS Development certificate
- `IOS_DISTRIBUTION` - iOS Distribution certificate
- `MAC_APP_DEVELOPMENT` - Mac App Development certificate
- `MAC_APP_DISTRIBUTION` - Mac App Distribution certificate
- `DEVELOPER_ID_APPLICATION` - Developer ID Application certificate
- `DEVELOPER_ID_INSTALLER` - Developer ID Installer certificate
- And others...

Cannot be used together with `certificate_types`.
- `certificate_types` (List of String) Filter Certificates by multiple types. Accepts a list of certificate type values.
Cannot be used together with `certificate_type`.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of Certificates to return. Must be between 1 and 200.
- `name_pattern` (String) Filter Certificates by name using a glob pattern. For example, `*Production*` to match Certificates containing 'Production' in the name.
- `platform` (String) Filter Certificates by platform. Valid values are:
- `IOS` - iOS platform
- `MAC_OS` - macOS platform
- `TV_OS` - tvOS platform
- `WATCH_OS` - watchOS platform

Cannot be used together with `platforms`.
- `platforms` (List of String) Filter Certificates by multiple platforms. Accepts a list of platform values.
Cannot be used together with `platform`.
- `serial_number` (String) Filter Certificates by exact serial number match.
- `sort_by` (String) Field to sort Certificates by. Valid values are:
- `display_name` - Sort by Certificate display name
- `name` - Sort by Certificate name
- `serial_number` - Sort by serial number
- `certificate_type` - Sort by certificate type
- `expiration_date` - Sort by expiration date

Defaults to `display_name` if not specified.
- `sort_order` (String) Sort order for the results. Valid values are:
- `asc` - Ascending order (default)
- `desc` - Descending order

### Read-Only

- `certificates` (Attributes List) List of Certificates that match the specified filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificates))
- `filtered_count` (Number) Number of Certificates after applying filters and before applying limit.
- `total_count` (Number) Total number of Certificates retrieved from Apple before filtering.

<a id="nestedatt--certificates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `certificates`

Read-Only:

- `certificate_content` (String, Sensitive) The Base64-encoded certificate content.
- `certificate_type` (String) The type of the certificate.
- `csr_content` (String) The Certificate Signing Request (CSR) content used to create this certificate.
- `display_name` (String) The display name for the Certificate.
- `expiration_date` (String) The expiration date of the certificate in RFC3339 format.
- `id` (String) The unique Apple-generated identifier for the Certificate.
- `name` (String) The name of the Certificate.
- `platform` (String) The platform for the Certificate (IOS, MAC_OS, TV_OS, WATCH_OS).
- `requester_email` (String) The email of the person who requested the certificate.
- `requester_first_name` (String) The first name of the person who requested the certificate.
- `requester_last_name` (String) The last name of the person who requested the certificate.
- `serial_number` (String) The serial number of the certificate.
